source.label: tab:b-results
source.caption: LLM review of joint target identification and evidence validity on 24 paired texts. A counted valid objection is a response that met the rules, challenges its selected claim, and supplies mathematically valid evidence under the source assumptions, after the recorded adjudications and the checks that the objection applies to the selected source claim. Table [ref:tab:b-results-appendix] gives the first-reader judgments and the counts across the recorded review stages.
